products.notes: Distributor copy of Pioneer spec. Sound processor + 4-ch amp: max 50 W x4 (or 50 W x2 @4 + 70 W x1 @2 for sub); continuous 22 W x4 @4 ohm 5% THD 50 Hz-15 kHz. Inputs: RCA + speaker-level (with sensing) + USB. 13-band graphic EQ (50 Hz-12.5 kHz, +/-12 dB, 0.1 dB steps; 31-band via Sound Tune app) - not per-channel parametric. Time alignment 0-350 cm in 2.5 cm steps (maxDelayMs 10.2 derived from 350 cm @343 m/s). Crossover std: HPF/LPF 50-200 Hz 0/-6..-24 dB/oct; network mode HPF 1.25-12.5 kHz, mid 25-250 Hz, sub LPF 25-250 Hz up to -36 dB/oct. 3 RCA pre outs (front/rear/sub) max 4.0 V, 250 ohm. S/N 105 dB, THD 0.01%. Supply 14.4 V (10.8-15.1), fuse 10 A. Pioneer Sound Tune app. Archived/discontinued.
